Hair Loss

Ailment hair-loss alopecia nutritional-deficiency hormonal

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Excessive hair loss due to nutritional deficiencies, hormonal imbalance, or autoimmune conditions.

Symptoms

  • thinning hair
  • patchy hair loss
  • brittle nails
  • skin problems
  • fatigue

Remedies for This Condition

  • Vitamin D
    Fat-soluble vitamin essential for bone health, immune modulation, and mood regulation.
  • N-Acetyl Cysteine (NAC)
    Precursor to glutathione, powerful antioxidant and mucolytic agent for liver and respiratory support.
  • Ashwagandha Root Extract
    Adaptogenic herb that helps the body manage stress, supports thyroid function, and reduces cortisol levels.
  • Evening Primrose Oil (EPO)
    Source of gamma-linolenic acid (GLA) for menopausal support and skin health.
